title: Judged failures are not learner difficulty
statement: Read the failure rates of generated items as evidence about the writer and the judge, not about what learners find hard.
example: From a topic where 3 of 6 generated items failed, an analysis wrote what students confuse, though no student had answered any item.
detail: From topic-level failure rates of generated questions, such as 3 failures among 6 items on one topic, an analysis agent wrote what 'students confuse' on that topic and set a 15-25% selection-rate target for each wrong option (`icloud-work/evaluator/analysis/reports/COMPREHENSIVE_FAILURE_REPORT.md`). The topic table comes from code over the judge's verdicts, and no learner had answered any of the items.

evidence.quote: - Students confuse different communist movements (Russian, Chinese, Cuban)
- Validate distractors represent 15-25% selection rate each
The 14-dimension evaluation cannot assess Rasch model fit, item discrimination, or guessing behavior — these require empirical response data.
